Welcome!
I’m Zhiqiang Wang, a Ph.D. candidate in Economics at School of Economics, Peking University. I received my Bachelor of Economics from the School of Economics, Peking University in 2021.
My research interests include the economics of climate change and environmental economics, and I also have a strong interest in quantitative economic history. Currently, I focus on how climate shocks influence the adaptation of industrial sector. I will be on the job market in the 2025–2026 academic year and welcome discussions and collaborations.

title: Research
text:
Publications

Xianling Long*, Zhiqiang Wang. From heat to high-tech: How innovation responds to climate change. Journal of Development Economics, 2025: 103525.
Link | 中文介绍 | 英文介绍






Abstract

This paper examines how firms respond to climate change through technological innovation. We emphasize that firms facing climate change are not always those innovating. Instead, innovation occurs either to mitigate a firm’s own climate-related damages (internal demand) or to supply climate-related technologies to other firms (external demand). To reflect this, we measure patent-specific exposure to climate change rather than traditional firm-level exposure to local temperatures. Our findings show that in China, climate adaptation patents increased by 8.62%, and climate mitigation patents grew by 10.68% in response to climate change. We document that new technologies respond positively to climate change due to rising public awareness, shifting demand, and regulatory pressures.

Zhiqiang Wang, Zhe Zhang*. Unlocking entrepreneurial growth: migrants and new firm entry in China. Applied Economics Letters, February 2025, 1-5. Link





Abstract

Using administrative data on firm registrations in China from 2000 to 2005 and employing a shift-share design, this study estimates the causal impact of rural-urban migration on new firm entry. Our findings show that the influx of migrants significantly increases new firm creation by reducing wages for low- skilled labour, thereby lowering labour costs for firms. This effect is especially pronounced in industries characterized by lower patent intensity, lower skill requirements, and higher labour intensity. The study underscores the vital role of labour mobility in driving entrepreneurial growth.

郝煜, 王志强, 张喆*. 轮船航运与市场整合——来自晚清中国的证据. 经济科学, 2025, 47(01):215-237. Link






Abstract

以蒸汽为主要动力的轮船的引进改进了内河航运的效率， 降低了交通成本，提高了清末中国的市场整合程度。 本文以清政府在 «马关条约» 后允许轮船进入非通商口岸的内河航运为准自然实验。 研究发现， 轮船航运提高了位于同一条长江支流的府对之间的市场整合程度， 相对于对照组， 这些府对间的粮价差异降低了 4.65%。 这解释了该地区这一时期实际粮价差异下降的 37%。 机制分析表明， 这种效应只在具备通航条件的长江支流以及通航条件较好的府对较为明显。 最后， 该效应对于运输距离较长、 贸易潜力较大的府对影响更大， 这表明轮船技术的应用存在固定成本和规模经济。 本文的发现表明近代以来的市场一体化受制于制度、 地理、 市场规模等因素， 呈现出曲折发展和时空局限的面貌， 从而为今天 “构建国内统一大市场” 战略的实施提供了有益的历史镜鉴。
